name: FlawedFictions
description: FlawedFictions is a benchmark designed to evaluate language models' ability to detect plot holes in stories, measuring nuanced reasoning skills such as entity tracking, abstract thinking, and narrative understanding. It uses a novel algorithm, FlawedFictionsMaker, to synthesize plot holes in human-written stories, with human filtering ensuring high quality and robustness to contamination.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for narrative reasoning and plot-hole detection, with limited but growing attention in story understanding research.
notes: Benchmark is robust to contamination with human filtering; performance degrades with longer stories; highlights LLMs' struggle with narrative consistency.
